owner_direction: Owner said they do not speak the sample languages and delegated the choice to the agents.
handover_choice: Disclosed automated eight-case policy audit replaces the earlier human-only pre-submission plan for this bounded hackathon handover; no human label approval is asserted.
method: Two fresh Codex agents with no inherited conversation context each received only the same fixed label-free packet and written protocol. Raw audit outputs were frozen before comparison with the original CSV labels.
independence_limit: Task-material separation only; both semantic judgments are AI-generated and may share language-model biases.
selection: Lowest SHA256 of UTF-8(seed + text) within each original proposed class/language stratum; selected cases sorted by the same hash, then assigned A through H.
human_adjudication: pending; required for stronger human-validated or real-customer quality claims
